definitions.full: H6623. pithron מִּתְרוֺן [Kö ii. 1, 154 ] noun masculine interpretation (of a dream), only Genesis 40:41; — construct מִּתְרוֺן Gen 40:5 ; 41:11 ; suffix מִּתְרֹנוֺ 40:12 , 18 ; plural מִּתְרֹנִים 40:8 .

occurrences.englishText: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.
They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.”
Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.
Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.
We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.
